# DSH-DREAM
> Status: v0.3.6 Pre-Alpha
**DSH-DREAM: Durable RAG-Enhanced Agent Memory**
**English | 简体中文**
## 1. Overview

DSH-DREAM is a local-first long-term memory layer for companions, assistants, and other
LLM agents.

It keeps hard constraints, recent conversation, retrieved memories, and audit
records separate, so t

he model gets useful context without turning every prompt into an
unreviewable pile of text.

The core idea is **holographic memory**: keep the ordinary moments, not just extracted
“facts”. The

complete user message and assistant reply are written unconditionally, while a
`system_fact` remains

a highlight tag for that turn. When **Holographic mode** is enabled in
DSH, the Host forces a write

at `agent/turn-stopping` even if the agent never calls a memory
tool.

DSH-DREAM ships as both a DSH community plugin and a Python library. Retrieval runs locally
by defau
lt; only the short retrieved context is sent to the LLM.

omatically provision a lightweight runtime and download a local embedding model (approx. 95MB). The
download and setup time depends on network conditions; please wait for the UI prompt. Subsequent ret
rievals will maintain lower latency.

Keep **“On dimension mismatch, try lossless re-embedding of old data”** enabled if you want
DSH-DREA

M to preserve the existing collection when the new model has a different vector
dimension. The store

caches the old documents and metadata, recreates the collection, and

## 4. Core Features

- **Four explicit layers.** Anchors (hard constraints), recent window, retrieved memories,
and audit

snapshots stay separate.
- **Holographic memory.** `assistant_message` is on the storage whitelist,

alongside
`user_message`, `system_fact`, and `tool_result`; `model_hint` is always rejected.
`Memor

yAgent` performs unconditional dual write of the full turn, and DSH Holographic mode
forces a write

at `agent/turn-stopping`.
- **State-slot conflict detection, not blanket latest-wins.** Only a direc

t location/state
change (“key in the shoe cabinet” → “key in the flower pot”) is collapsed. A sequen

ce such
as “bought a mug → broke it → bought a replacement” is preserved.
- **Dual-track Memory.** D
istinguishes between state updates and event timelines. Conflict resolution overrides outdated prefe

rences while retaining the full timeline of evolving events.
- **Timeline retrieval.** `timeline_mod

e=True` skips conflict collapsing and returns the
relevant raw memories in ascending timestamp order

.
- **Local-first by default.** Retrieval uses local Chroma plus BM25; the LLM only sees a
compact e

vidence block, not the whole database.
- **Auditable by design.** Each request records retrieved chu

nk IDs, a window hash, and the
anchor version.
- **Safety boundaries.** Anchor payloads are capped a

t 2000 tokens; retrieved text is
untrusted background evidence; user text is delimiter-isolated.
